lessons: An existing PR can still be locally verified for evidence, but it rules out a competing contribution.

lessons: The best score was 0.0217, so generic evaluation advice was correctly withheld.

subtasks.description: Execute the documented operations and compare every result

constraints: Keep the repair to one documentation file.
Do not change library behavior or open a duplicate PR.
Do not access credentials or external services.
lessons: Execute documentation in its displayed order and compare each value, not merely whether the snippet exits zero.
Give independent fluent transformations a named immutable baseline so presentation order cannot leak state.
AEG correctly abstained because neither verified record covered documentation examples or timezone state.
A locally improved open-PR patch is verification evidence, not maintainer acceptance or authorization to publish.
